app_context: Multi-Tenant WhatsApp Commerce + Ecommerce Management + Order Fulfilment SaaS (Master Admin + Tenant Client Dashboard)
design_archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Authority, Clarity, Truth) combined with Performance Pro for inventory and order operations
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a production-ready, multi-tenant SaaS platform with Master Admin and Client Dashboard views.

Support tenant switching, tenant isolation, products/catalog management, inventory alerts, order fulfilment queues (picking/packing/delivery/pickup), WhatsApp chat assistant simulator, customer CRM, and analytics.
Every interactive element and key info badge MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Ensure all modals and dropdowns have opaque backgrounds.
universal_guidelines: Never use full-screen transparent headers without blur.
Ensure all interactive items have hover and focus states.
Respect dark/light modes and maintain high contrast.
